merger_name: Vista Equity Partners – Enterprise Trust Business of HID Global Corporation

anzsic_codes.name: Computer System Design and Related Services

merger_description:
Vault Buyer, Inc., which is controlled by funds managed and/or controlled by Vista Equity Partners Management, LLC (together with its affiliates, **Vista**), will acquire, pursuant to an equity purchase agreement, 100% of the equity interests in Nomad CM LLC, IdenTrust, Inc., ASSA ABLOY Access AB and ZeroSSL GmbH (together, the **Target Group**) from HID Global Corporation, ASSA ABLOY AB and ASSA ABLOY Holding AB (the **Acquisition**).  

  

Vista is a US-based investment firm specialising in investing in and growing enterprise software, data and technology-enabled businesses, investing through private equity, permanent capital, credit and public equity investment strategies through its fund vehicles.  

  

The Target Group is a provider of digital trust software, including enterprise public key infrastructure (**PKI**), public trust, Secure Sockets Layer/Transport Layer Security (**SSL/TLS**) and credential management services, supplied through four business lines: IdenTrust (public trust certificate authority), HydrantID (PKI-as-a-Service), ZeroSSL (self-service SSL/TLS certificates) and ActivID (credential management). The Target Group is currently ultimately owned by ASSA ABLOY AB.  

  

The Target Group’s primary business is concentrated in the United States. It does not have any subsidiaries, employees or premises in Australia. On completion, the Target Group will be solely controlled by funds managed and/or controlled by Vista.

events.title: Notification waiver determination published

determination_table_content.details:
In making this notification waiver determination, the Australian
Competition and Consumer Commission (the ACCC) has considered
the information provided with the notification waiver application and
had regard to the factors in section 51ABV(2)(b) of the Competition
and Consumer Act 2010 (Cth) (the Act).
Based on the information provided in the application, the ACCC
considers that the Acquisition is unlikely to give rise to any material
lessening of competition given there is no horizontal overlap or
vertical relationship between Vista (or its connected entities) and the
Enterprise Trust Business of HID Global Corporation in Australia.
In these circumstances, the ACCC does not consider it necessary to
reach a concluded view on the likelihood of the notification
thresholds being met.
Given that material competition concerns are unlikely to arise, the
ACCC has determined that the Acquisition is not required to be
notified.
The ACCC considers that the determination is consistent with the
object of the Act and the interests of consumers in promoting
competition.
For more information about the ACCC’s approach to considering
notification waiver applications and to assessing competition
effects more generally, see the ACCC’s guidance on notification
waivers and merger assessment guidelines.
